title: 第十七章 绑架
content_zh:
陈木安静的在房间中修炼着，这对于他来说已经是十分习惯的一件事，对于修真者来说，往往打坐修炼，再次苏醒，就是数月、数年甚至数百年。

    陈木盘腿坐在床上，双手交接，摆着一个印诀，双目紧闭着，均匀的呼吸着，若是外人看去，陈木此刻身上散发着淡淡的微光，这些光芒随着陈木的呼吸忽现忽灭。

    随着陈木的实力达到练气二层，真气的吸收速度也快了一些，当然没有辅助药丸支撑，就算是修炼一百年，陈木也不可能突破到练气三层，尽快如此，陈木也知道辅助的修炼药丸的效果对于练气二层的他来说，效果基本上微乎其微了。

    陈木现在要做的就是等待银叶草的成熟。

    修炼中的陈木对于外界的一切感官似乎都消失了，只知道无休止的修炼，当陈木感觉体内的真气已经无法在提升半步的时候，陈木微微睁开了双眼，喃喃道：“现在自己已经练气二层，若没有银叶草的辅助，恐怕没有办法再次提升实力了。”

    陈木看着身边自己准备的那些药丸，摇了摇头，药丸的作用已经没有多大的作用了，只能起到最基本的补充真气的作用，收好药丸，陈木透过窗外看着漫天的星空。

    他在想自己何时可以回到苍月大陆，还有在自己被追杀的时候，救自己的那个人到底是谁？

    陈木叹息了一声，现在已经无法提升修为了，不过陈木并不准备就停止修炼，古武—擒拿手，陈木自然研究了一番，这属于一套近战武术，在修真界以法术为主，近战武术反而没有人修炼，但现在陈木既然已经得到了这套古武，陈木自然要修炼一番，不然光是靠练气二层的实力，陈木没有太强的安全感。

    想到此，陈木出门找到了一块没人的空地，按照脑海中的古武招式，一招一招的练习了起来，渐渐地陈木发现，古武的修炼如果自身没有真气，那么并没有多大的作用，但有了真气的加入，这套古武，竟然有了一丝融入天地的气势。

    砰！

    陈木一拳对着一块岩石打去，在陈木有些惊讶的目光中，岩石直接裂了开来，虽然陈木也可以用法术或者真气灌注拳中，达到这种效果。但运行古武后，达到这种效果，仅仅只用了原来真气的十分之一。

    这样的发现让陈木心中有些惊喜，这就保证了他能够在节省本就不多的真气前提下，发挥出百分之一百的实力，陈木此刻也有些佩服这些创造古武的人来，这是以前在苍月大陆所不具备的功法。
content_en:
Chen Mu practiced quietly in the room. This was something he was very accustomed to. For cultivators, it often takes months, years or even hundreds of years to wake up again after meditating.

Chen Mu sat cross-legged on the bed, holding hands together and making a seal. He closed his eyes tightly and breathed evenly. If an outsider looked at it, Chen Mu would be exuding a faint glimmer of light. These lights would appear and disappear with Chen Mu's breathing.

As Chen Mu's strength reached the second level of Qi training, the speed of absorbing Qi became faster. Of course, without the support of auxiliary pills, even if he practiced for a hundred years, Chen Mu would not be able to break through to the third level of Qi training. As soon as possible, Chen Mu also knew that the effect of the auxiliary training pills would be minimal for him at the second level of Qi training.

What Chen Mu has to do now is to wait for the silver-leaf grass to mature.

During the training, Chen Mu seemed to have lost all sense of the outside world. He only knew endless training. When Chen Mu felt that the Qi in his body could no longer improve even half a step, Chen Mu opened his eyes slightly and murmured: "Now I have reached the second level of Qi training. Without the assistance of Silver Leaf Grass, I am afraid there is no way to improve my strength again."

Chen Mu looked at the pills he had prepared beside him and shook his head. The pills no longer had much effect. They could only play the most basic role in replenishing Qi. After putting the pills away, Chen Mu looked at the starry sky through the window.

He was thinking about when he could return to Cang Yue Continent, and who was the person who saved him when he was being hunted?

Chen Mu sighed, it was impossible to improve his cultivation now, but Chen Mu was not ready to stop practicing. Ancient martial arts - Capture Master, Chen Mu naturally studied it. This is a set of melee martial arts. In the world of cultivation, spells are the main focus. No one practices melee martial arts. But now that Chen Mu has obtained this set of ancient martial arts, Chen Mu naturally has to practice some. Otherwise, Chen Mu will not have a strong sense of security just relying on the strength of the second level of Qi training.

Thinking of this, Chen Mu went out and found an empty space where there was no one. He practiced the ancient martial arts moves in his mind one by one. Gradually, Chen Mu discovered that the practice of ancient martial arts was of little use if he did not have true energy. But with the addition of true energy, this set of ancient martial arts actually had the aura to blend into the world.

Bang!

Chen Mu punched a rock. In Chen Mu's surprised eyes, the rock cracked open. Although Chen Mu could also use magic or true energy to infuse the fist to achieve this effect.But after running Gu Wu, only one-tenth of the original Qi was used to achieve this effect.

Such a discovery made Chen Mu feel a little surprised. It ensured that he could exert 100% of his strength while saving his little energy. At this moment, Chen Mu also admired these people who created ancient martial arts. This was a technique that was not available in Cangyue Continent before.
